title: Flappy Oomf: I'm So Hungry I Could Eat An Oomf
story: You are an Oomf! porridge pot on a supermarket shelf, and the whole timeline is so hungry it could eat an oomf. The spoons are coming. Panic-hop between them before someone has you for breakfast.
inspiration: @turbochis on X, 2026-11-22: 'im so hungry i could eat an oomf' over a photo of Oomf! protein porridge pots on a UK supermarket shelf (85p), 142k likes / 1.2M views in a day, quote chain of 'found a few oomfs' shelf pics through 11-23 (https://x.com/i/status/2124377976653681044; X story https://x.com/i/trending/2124776598800937000). Joke: 'oomf' = one of my followers, so you ARE the oomf being hunted. Bird: the front Oomf! pot cut out of the actual meme photo (rembg isnet + largest-component cleanup, white sticker outline). Pillar: stainless teaspoon cutout, bowl toward the gap so spoons dive in from above and scoop from below (Wikimedia Commons File:Teaspoon.jpg, S Sepp, CC BY-SA 3.0). Sky: the meme's own shelf photo, blurred and dimmed. Archetype: Twitchy — tiny panicked hops of a snack that knows it is about to be eaten. Rolling 7-day window (11-18 Afterburner, 11-19 Gauntlet, 11-20 Brick, 11-21 Giant, 11-22 Moon Gravity, 11-23 Speed Demon) gets a 7th distinct archetype and a third extreme day; Twitchy last used 11-17.
